name: Noxious Lair
summary: In Tanaris, Centipaar silithid have made the Noxious Lair their home. They drained the water from a sunken basin near Un'Goro Crater and raised an acidic hive above rich mineral veins.

sections.title: A Drained Basin
sections.body: Beside the western ridges above Un'Goro Crater, the Noxious Lair fills a sandy hollow. A lake or shallow river once lay here, but the Centipaar silithid consumed the remaining underground moisture and claimed the basin. Now pincers and twitching limbs rise from the dunes above tunnels in the sand. Corrosive secretions coat the passages, and clusters of eggs fill the chambers.

sections.title: The Centipaar Swarm
sections.body: Entrances descend into humid breeding chambers slick with acid. Centipaar workers, tunnelers, wasps, and colossal sandreavers patrol the perimeter and guard their brood from outside threats. Their digging has exposed deep mineral deposits too. Ore lies bare among the hives, drawing hunters and prospectors to the basin.

faq.q: What kind of creatures live in the Noxious Lair?
aliases: what mobs are in noxious lair
faq.answer: Centipaar silithid fill the hive. Workers, burrowing tunnelers, flying wasps, and predatory sandreavers defend it. Rare hive terrors such as Soriid the Devourer rule within.

faq.q: What was here before the silithid took over?
faq.answer: A riverbed or shallow desert lake once filled the sunken basin. The silithid burrowed underground and drained western Tanaris of vital water and natural resources, leaving an acid-soaked hollow.

faq.q: Why are goblins interested in this hive?
faq.answer: Gadgetzan goblins see the hive as a danger to desert commerce. They have sent adventurers to investigate the lair and the silithid expansion.

faq.q: Is the Noxious Lair connected to other insect hives in the desert?
faq.answer: The Noxious Lair is the Centipaar hive, one of several insect colonies spreading from the southern wastes. Its tunnels are separate from hives farther south, yet share their eerie underground design and threaten life across Tanaris.

angles.text: Silithid burrowing has exposed many kinds of ore in the basin. You can find Iron, Mithril, Truesilver, and Thorium veins in the same territory.
As a druid, you see how invasive silithid drained a once-watered basin and turned it into an arid, acidic wasteland.
